# Kalvez

> Kalvez is the AI platform for trade businesses: stronger Google visibility, clearer websites, more local traffic, and booked jobs.

Kalvez helps plumbers, HVAC companies, roofers, electricians, general contractors, landscapers, and other local trades show up when customers search and turn that attention into calls.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://kalvez.com/): Product overview for trade owners who want more jobs from Google
- [Free digital presence report](https://kalvez.com/report): Lead magnet that scores Map Pack, organic search, Google Business Profile, website experience, and competitors
- [Book a free demo](https://kalvez.com/free-demo): 20-minute walkthrough of listing and website gaps
- [Trades](https://kalvez.com/trades): Growth pages by trade
- [Services](https://kalvez.com/services): Local SEO, websites, reviews, CRM, scheduling, and related services
- [Blog](https://kalvez.com/blog): Practical tips on Google, websites, reviews, and booking jobs
